content: A 30-day grace period applies after the premium due date before coverage lapses.
Plans renew annually; renewal options are sent at least 45 days before the plan end date.
Eligible dependents can be added within 30 days of a qualifying life event.
You may cancel with 30 days' written notice; unused premium is refunded pro rata.

Insurance and pension benefits unlock once your total paid premiums reach {eligibility_threshold} {currency}. Premiums are paid quarterly, at {quarterly_premium} {currency} per quarter on the standard plan.
Pension benefits become available once the eligibility threshold of {eligibility_threshold} {currency} in paid premiums is reached. Ask me for your eligibility to see how much remains.
Insurance benefits become available once the eligibility threshold of {eligibility_threshold} {currency} in paid premiums is reached. The benefits that apply to you are listed in your plan documents.
Premiums are billed quarterly. You can pay in this chat after signing in: review the quote I prepare and reply 'confirm'. Nothing is charged until you confirm.
If a premium is not paid by its due date it becomes overdue; the 30-day grace period applies before coverage lapses.
Claims are filed by submitting a claim with the supporting documents described in your plan documents.
Beneficiaries are named in your plan documents and can be updated by contacting member services.
